text:
nico: hi all, first-week question — I wrote up a quick checklist for the service handoff during onboarding. Where's the canonical place to put it so others can find and reuse it? Should I edit the team runbook directly or keep it in My Pages until reviewed?

marta-devex: welcome Nico! Put drafts in My Pages first. Once you're ready, create a clean page and ask for a docs review. We don't want half-finished drafts in the team space. Canonical local for infra runbooks is /Team Docs/Engineering/Infra/Runbooks (https://redwood.notion.so/eng-infra-runbooks).

nico: got it. I tried to move a page from My Pages into /Team Docs but the move option was disabled. I see "Can view" on the parent page.

jamal-infra: that means most folks are Viewer by default. Two quick ways: 1) On the runbook page click Share -> Request access and ping @marta-devex; or 2) Use the docs-bot helper: `@docs-bot request-edit <notion-link> reason:review` — that will open a ticket for the docs maintainers.

nico: thanks. Also, I want to make a template out of this checklist so new hires can reuse it. Can I just copy the page into /Templates/engineering?

marta-devex: please don't copy a draft into the Templates space. The Template button needs specific metadata. Workflow: draft in My Pages -> request template review with `@docs-bot new-template <link> short-summary` -> maintainers will run the docs-lint check (link resolution, required page properties, template button config) -> maintainers publish the Template into /Templates/engineering.

jamal-infra: adding some specifics: Template pages require these page properties: `Owner`, `Template Owner`, `Status` (Proposal/Draft/Published), and `Tags`. We also run an automated link-check when you request publication. If you want to test the template button locally, create a copy in My Pages and use the "Template" icon to instantiate it.

nico: what's the naming convention for runbooks/templates? I usually do kebab-case like service-handoff-checklist.

marta-devex: for discoverability we use a prefixed human title: `eng-infra - Service handoff - YYYY-MM` (spaces allowed). Also add a short slug property `slug: eng-infra/service-handoff` if the page will be a template. For ad-hoc notes keep kebab-case titles in My Pages if you prefer.

nico: will moving the page later preserve comments/mentions/backlinks?

jamal-infra: yes. Use Move -> select destination. Notion preserves comments/backlinks. Only caveat: moving a page that's used as a Template source can break the template button if you move the original Template page. That's why maintainers publish the template in the Templates space for stability.

docs-bot: Action: docs review request created by nico for https://redwood.notion.so/nico/service-handoff-checklist. Ticket DOCS-514 assigned to infra-docs-maintainers. Lint: pending.

nico: sweet — i'll tidy the checklist, add the required properties, and hit the bot. One last thing: can new hires get temporary edit rights to iterate faster?

marta-devex: yes — request edit access via the bot or put a note in the request. We typically grant Editor for 7 days while the author iterates, then we revert to Viewer to keep template hygiene. If you need a longer window, include justification in the request.

nico: perfect, thanks for the quick help 🙏 :party_parrot:

(jamal-infra reacted with :thumbsup: and marta-devex pinned the docs-bot message)
